mission: Inside the breach, each person shows what unweaving does to them, and Ben comes out of it carrying two facts his body understands before his mind can explain them.
why_now: The unwoven zone strips performance off everyone in it. Each character's honest register surfaces when the Force can no longer mediate. Per D7, Torin's register here is withheld rather than exposed — his direction is not the answer the midpoint delivers; the answer is the embodied experience of full unweaving, plus two pieces of load-bearing knowledge that travel through Ben's body rather than through exposition.
conflict: Sera fights to hold discipline against the missing second blade. Kael navigates the zone with unexpected ease. Desh reports environmental data the way he always reports environmental data while grief that does not know its object lands on him. Torin's Force presence changes in the deepest part of the breach and Ben cannot read which way it changed. The withheld answer is the most pressure-loaded ambiguity in the story so far.
turning_point: Ben's body understands two things before his mind does. First: the zone's shape is anchored to a geographical specific, and the only place Veraine's ritual can complete is Veranthos. Second: the surviving anchors are drawing harder on each other than they were the last time he sensed them. Neither of these lands as a sentence; both land as felt-fact. Meanwhile, Torin stops at the worst of the breach and stands unreadable.
opening_hook: Inside the unwoven zone: the Force arrives in pieces, each voice partial. Sera's hands clench. Kael moves like someone whose feet know the ground. Torin walks toward the worst of it and does not come back for a long time
closing_hook: They leave the zone. The Weave snaps back — the relief is immediate and physical. Ben looks at Torin and cannot read what is in him. He does not know what Ben is looking for. Ben does not know what he is looking at
emotional_trajectory: Group distress differentiated by training -> Ben's body absorbing two load-bearing facts without language -> Torin's unreadable return -> held ambiguity on departure

stakes.personal: Ben's pattern-recognition pressurising without the vocabulary to name what he is reading — per D1 Trauma Lie under test, his capacity to judge whose Force-reading is trustworthy is specifically the skill the midpoint asks him to use without any of the usual instruments
stakes.interpersonal: The group has been inside full unweaving together. Something happened to Torin. No one has a name for what they saw or did not see.
stakes.external: If the wound opens fully, this is what the galaxy feels. Veranthos is the specific site. Cascade is accelerating.

setting: Breach Zone — deep inside the unwoven area, then retreat to the perimeter
sensory_details: The Force as multiple voices speaking at once, each partial — Ben assembling nothing; Sera's bilateral muscle memory meeting no reciprocal pressure and compensating every beat late; Kael's breathing steady in a place where everyone else's pattern has broken; Desh's face registering a sadness without an object, noted in his tone but not in his speech; Torin walking into the dead centre of the breach and staying there; the Weave snapping back on exit with a relief Ben feels behind his sternum; Torin's face on turning, absolutely still, absolutely unreadable
canon_elements_needed: Force wound phenomenology in full-unweaving register
Geographical anchoring of Force rituals in Legends metaphysics
action_beats: Sera's hands clench and her body braces against a pressure that does not arrive — her Force-lock training running without its reciprocal
Kael moves through the zone with the economy of someone who is finally home; his breathing does not change
Ben reaches for the Force and gets multiple partial voices, each a fraction; he stops assembling

Desh's chrono-drift readings line up in Ben's peripheral vision with what Ben's body is sensing about the zone's shape — Veranthos as the only completion site resolves as felt-fact, not as a spoken conclusion
Ben's attention registers the surviving anchors drawing harder on each other than before — a multiplicative coupling he cannot put into words, planted for later
Torin walks into the worst of it, stops, stands there a long time
Torin turns; his face is unreadable; the group absorbs the silence and steps out of the zone
promises_planted: The array-dependency fact (plants Ch 13, pays Ch 14 onward, ultimate Ch 25-26)
Cascade-acceleration as tactical constraint (plants Ch 13, reinforces Ch 18, pays Ch 21)
notes: Stay inside the experience. Torin must remain unreadable here, and the new knowledge should arrive as sensation, not analysis.
